actions_taken: Implemented buyer offer inspection over the task-required order_reading tool and xyz.artiji/commerce extension.
Duplicated all six material terms in the standard MCP tool description and in structured extension fields.
Implemented refusal before approval or payment when the tool, structured fields, or description disclosure is incomplete.
Wired the USD 150 decision through an injected TrueForge human-checkpoint approval port; P2 never calls the payment handler.
Added six append-only gap-log entries, one for each buyer-required disclosure field absent from standard MCP/MPP metadata.
Ran the Node 24 test suite: five tests pass; the P3 idempotency and P4 cold-resume tests remain intentionally red.
key_results: The extension contains exactly six structured disclosure fields: price, fulfillmentMode, expectedWindow, resultType, refundPolicy, and cancellationPolicy.
A missing cancellationPolicy produces MATERIAL_TERMS_INCOMPLETE with paymentAttempted=false and approvalRequested=false.
With complete disclosure, the USD 150 purchase reaches the human approval port and returns APPROVAL_PENDING without a payment attempt.
The baseline tool description independently carries all six terms, so a client can see them even when it ignores extension metadata.

assumptions_made.assumption: The six structured terms belong under xyz.artiji/commerce until a standard MCP payment/commerce discovery representation exists.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: A ratified MCP or MPP extension normatively defines these fields for MCP tools.

assumptions_made.assumption: The injected approval callback faithfully represents the point where TrueForge's human-checkpoint configuration will be attached.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: TrueForge's configured approval API cannot invoke an application callback or requires a different state contract.

extension_fields_added: price — standard MCP metadata has no structured paid-tool amount/currency field.
fulfillmentMode — standard MCP metadata has no immediate-versus-deferred fulfillment field.
expectedWindow — standard MCP metadata has no fulfillment-window field.
resultType — standard MCP Tasks has no expected deferred-artifact type field.
refundPolicy — standard MCP/MPP metadata has no merchant refund-policy field.
cancellationPolicy — standard MCP Tasks has no paid-tool cancellation-policy field.
scope_creep_surfaced: No TrueForge model provider or live UI approval configuration was created; the tested callback is the application boundary and avoids requiring a separate model credential in P2.
No payment credential was sent and no Stripe API call occurred; money-path implementation remains P3.
next_phase_readiness_reason: Disclosure and approval contracts pass, and P3 can implement the isolated Stripe test-mode payment and durable idempotency path only after the literal token go.
